experiment_data.hypothesis: 3B signals v5. Parallel with v4 (cuda:3). Compute embedding/minkpp/selfcritique for d025 and d100 only. Accelerates signal coverage by splitting workload across cuda:3 (v4) and cuda:4 (v5).
experiment_data.notes: 失败原因: EXIT_CODE=129 (SIGHUP), 实际是 d100_s42/mmlu selfcritique 在 22% 处被 SIGTERM (D078/D079 orphan 清理). 3/4 batch tasks 完成 (d025_s42/mmlu PASS, d100_s42/gsm8k PASS, d100_s42/arc_challenge PASS). 已有成果: d025_s42 和 d100_s42 的 gsm8k+arc signals 已写盘, 但这些 signals 基于旧 alpha=16 checkpoint, D076 重训 alpha=32 后需全部重算, 无需单独 retry. 建议: 等 cuda:1 d100_s42_v3 + cuda:5 d000_s42 重训完成后, 用新 checkpoint 统一重算 3B s42 signals.
